note: Both sets share the same core claims, including the correct keynote-to-name bindings (BOOSTER PUMP 22 11 23, DOMESTIC WATER PIPING 22 11 16, HTP SUPERSTOR SOLAR WATER TANK 22 33 00, SOLAR PUMP STATION 23 56 01, DISHWASHER 11 31 13.A7) and the four elevation callouts with the ground-plane condition. Set B adds one extra claim ('floor | finish height | 2'-0 3/8"') that merely restates the Finish Floor elevation already captured, with a vague entity and a mislabeled attribute, so it is a duplicate of no added value. Set A is therefore slightly cleaner, since it carries the same correct content without that redundant claim. Both sets also duplicate the ceiling-finish elevation and leave the general sheet notes (waste pipe slope, PVC piping) unextracted.
remarks: Both sets bind 22 11 23.A2 to a generic 'Water Supply System' although the reference keynotes list it as SUMP PUMP; likewise 11 31 23.A1 (CLOTHES WASHER), 22 41 23.B3 (PRE-FABRICATED SHOWER STALL) and 22 13 00 (FACILITY SANITARY SEWERAGE) are reduced to vague 'plumbing system / system | component identifier' claims. The four 'location | ... assembly' claims are not supported by the text layer and their spatial labels cannot be verified from the image. Both sets omit the General Sheet Notes engineering facts: all waste pipe slopes minimum 1/4 in/ft per 2009 IRC, and all supply and waste pipe to be PVC piping. Both also state the CEILING FINISH elevation twice under two spellings.
